question: Which of the following rivers is also known as ‘Dakshin Ganga’ ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Godavari River**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Godavari River is the **second-longest river in India**, after the Ganga, with a length of approximately 1,465 kilometers.
 
• It originates from **Trimbak in the Nashik district of Maharashtra** and flows eastward into the Bay of Bengal.
 
• It is referred to as the **'Dakshin Ganga' (Ganga of the South)** due to its immense significance for irrigation, agriculture, and cultural heritage in southern India.
 
• The river flows through the states of Maharashtra, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, and Odisha, making it a lifeline for millions in these regions.
 
• Major tributaries of the Godavari include the **Pranhita, Indravati, Manjira, and Sabari Rivers**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Origin and Course:**

 
 
• The Godavari originates from the **Brahmagiri Hills** in the Western Ghats.
 
• Its drainage basin is the largest in peninsular India, covering about **312,812 square kilometers**.
 
 
 
• **Cultural Significance:**
 
 
• The Godavari is considered sacred in Hinduism and hosts the **Kumbh Mela** at Nashik every 12 years.
 
• It is associated with several ancient Indian texts and epics, including the **Ramayana**.
 
 
 
• **Economic Importance:**
 
 
• The river is vital for **irrigation and hydroelectric power generation** in peninsular India.
 
• The **Polavaram Project** on the Godavari is a major multi-purpose irrigation project in Andhra Pradesh.
 
 
 
• **Environmental Aspects:**
 
 
• The Godavari basin is home to diverse ecosystems, including **mangroves, wetlands, and wildlife sanctuaries**.
 
• However, the river faces challenges like **pollution and over-exploitation**, necessitating conservation efforts.
